item.title: Mariska Hargitay helped fund testing of 11,341 rape kits in Detroit; 263 convictions followed
item.description: American actress Mariska Hargitay helped support a project to test 11,341 sexual assault evidence kits discovered in a Detroit police warehouse in 2009.
